study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective multicenter observational cohort study
cohort: 1,692 patients undergoing labor induction with cervical ripening from the French Methods of Induction of Labor and Perinatal Outcomes study
finding: The study developed and validated a new score for predicting cesarean delivery after labor induction with cervical ripening, which showed good predictive ability with an AUC of 0.81 on external validation.
